help: Canon cases for tools/ci/javadoc_check.ps1. Each case lists files with full 'before' and 'after' content; the runner commits 'before' as the base, 'after' as HEAD, and the check inspects git diff BaseRef..HEAD. The check must flag every added public/protected type or method declaration under bundles/*/src (non-tests) that has no Javadoc block directly above it (annotation lines may sit between the doc and the declaration). expected: pass|fail.
